answer: The comet test I would run is Anointed lab technician registration with science technicians attestation: a registration technicians renew after bench audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a registration technicians renew after bench audits — so privacy survives, and the relic is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the velvet of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
